sentences.text: Dispute arose between the petitioners and the respondent no.2, which resulted in filing of the present FIR by the respondent no.2 against the petitioners.

6. Now the parties have settled all their disputes before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Tis Hazari Courts in terms of Settlement dated 25th January, 2023, which has been filed as Annexure P-3 to the petition.
The parties have also been granted divorce by mutual consent vide decree dated 5th April, 2023.
7. Issue notice.
8. Notice is accepted by the learned APP appearing on behalf of the State and the counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no.2.
9. The respondent no.2 is present in Court and has been identified by her counsel as well as by the Investigating Officer (IO).
She informs the Court that she has settled the matter of her own free will and without any coercion.
She further states that she has no objection to quashing of the FIR.
10. The petitioners are also present in Court and have been identified by their counsel.
They affirm the statement of the respondent no.2 and undertake to abide by the terms of settlement arrived at between the parties.
11. As per the settlement, a sum of Rs.33,00,000/- was payable to the respondent no.2.
Out of the aforesaid amount, a sum of Rs.22,00,000/- has already been paid.
The petitioners have brought a demand draft of Rs.11,00,000/- in Court today and the same has been handed over to the respondent no.2.
12. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/09/2023 at 19:26:24 of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Hence, it would be in the interest of justice to quash the aforementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
13. Consequently, the FIR No.412/2018 at Police Station Neb Sarai and the proceedings pursuant thereto are quashed.
14. The petition stands disposed of.
